podcast.title: Early LP Domain (1950s)
podcast.body: In the early 1950s, Broadway show music was considered "serious music" and primarily released on 12-inch LPs. "serious music, which would be classical jazz, Broadway show music, was found on LPs."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: More Granular Classification
podcast.body: Broadway show music was recognized as a specific genre in 1955, indicating that even amidst broad musical classifications, there was a capacity for detailed categorization, anticipating the future explosion of micro-genres. "You could slice certain genres into thinner slices to include big band, Dixie Land, Scott, Hillbilly, and Jazz, gospel, Broadway show music."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
